name: COMET
description: COMET is a task-oriented dialog dataset containing 11.5k user-assistant dialogs grounded in simulated personal memory graphs. It supports multi-turn, interactive conversations for searching personal media collections, enabling evaluation of dialog systems in multimodal and memory-grounded contexts.
reputation: A relatively new multimodal dialog dataset that is useful for memory-grounded conversation research but has not yet become a widely standardized benchmark.
notes: Dataset collected via a two-phase pipeline with synthetic dialog simulation and manual paraphrasing; focuses on multimodal dialog grounded in memory graphs.
